editorial:
Imagine being a regular guy who suddenly becomes a giant among tiny people. That is the wild ride you get here. Lemuel Gulliver is a travel writer who gets sent to Bermuda but washes up on the island of Liliput. There, the locals are only inches tall, and he towers over everything. At first, they fear him, but soon he becomes their hero. The movie mixes big laughs with silly adventure, and Jack Black brings his usual goofy energy to the role. The tiny world looks fun, with little castles and tiny soldiers running around. It is a light, family-friendly comedy that does not take itself too seriously.

The pacing moves quickly, so kids will stay interested. The special effects are decent, though some scenes feel a bit cheesy. The humor is mostly silly and slapstick, which works for a family night. On the downside, the story is pretty simple and predictable. Still, if you want a fun, easy watch with your family, this delivers. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Gulliver helps the Liliputians defeat their enemies and saves the kingdom. He also wins the heart of the princess and earns the respect of the tiny people. The twist is that Gulliver realizes he does not need to be a giant to matter. He returns home with a new sense of confidence and purpose. The movie ends on a happy note, with Gulliver sharing his adventure and feeling proud of who he is. It is a sweet, simple conclusion that wraps up the story nicely.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family comedies with silly humor and adventure.
